resolutions.researcher_notes: Brief's seed URL petro-news.com/95212/ (Petro News, Egyptian energy trade outlet, 'خريطة مشروعات الغاز الطبيعي في مصر', published 2024-10-10) actually resolves live (200) despite the DEAD_LINK flag; re-verified. It lists the Idku-Abu Hummus doubling as one of Egypt's current natural-gas projects (30km, 42-inch, 733M EGP), present-tense description consistent with an in-service line as of late 2024. Corroborated independently by Al-Dostor newspaper (dostor.org/4234553, 2022-11-18), headlined 'By directives of President Sisi.. development of the Idku-Abu Hummus line to boost gas exports' -- reports the line 'تم تطوير' (has been developed/upgraded) to reinforce the national grid, same 30km/42-inch/733M EGP specs. Status is inferred from context per confidence_tiers guidance (no literal 'operating' token expected) -- two independent outlets (trade press + national newspaper), 2 years apart, both describe a completed, functioning transmission line. No source suggests the line is idle, under construction, or decommissioned.

Seed URL egy-map.com re-verified live (200); despite the DEAD_LINK flag it resolves and contains the exact figures. egy-map.com ('Egypt's Projects Map') states its own source as the Egyptian Presidency's official website, and gives 'تاريخ التنفيذ: فبراير ٢٠٢٠' (execution date: February 2020) for this project, directly matching ConstructionYear=2020 (also implies ConstructionMonth=2/February, though that field isn't in the current values). CONTRADICTION TO FLAG: a Youm7 (اليوم السابع) year-in-review piece published 2020-01-02 ('2020.. عام الغاز والذهب الأسود') lists the Idku/Abu Hummus doubling within a summary of '6 gas-grid lines totaling ~292km commissioned during 2019' (https://www.youm7.com/story/2020/1/2/.../4570084) -- length/diameter math (3+29+165+65+30=292km) ties it to that same cohort, and every other line in the list carries an explicit 2019 commissioning month (Feb/Feb/Jul/Nov/Dec 2019), but the Idku/Abu Hummus item alone carries no month, making it ambiguous whether it slipped into very-early 2020 (consistent with egy-map's Feb 2020) or was substantially 2019 work that egy-map dated by a later administrative/inauguration date. Not citing Youm7 as the ref (it points toward 2019, not the current 2020 value) -- flagging only for a human to reconcile ConstructionYear if the Presidency's Feb-2020 'تاريخ التنفيذ' is an inauguration date rather than true completion. egy-map.com alone is a single (non-independent) source for the literal year value, hence tier=medium.

Three sources, all live and re-verified, state the identical figure '733 مليون جنيه' (733 million EGP) for this project: Al-Dostor newspaper (2022-11-18, presidency-directed development framing), Petro News trade outlet (2024-10-10, Egypt gas-projects map roundup), and egy-map.com's 'Egypt's Projects Map' (sourced to the Presidency's official website). Two of these (Dostor, Petro News) are genuinely independent editorial outlets, not wire reprints of each other -- satisfies the >=2-independent bar; egy-map added as a third, Presidency-sourced corroboration. CONTRADICTION TO FLAG: an earlier Youm7 (اليوم السابع) article published 2020-01-02 gives a different figure, '716 مليون جنيه' (716 million EGP), for the same doubling project (https://www.youm7.com/story/2020/1/2/.../4570084). This is plausibly an early/interim cost estimate (article predates or coincides with completion) later revised upward to the final 733M EGP cited consistently by all three 2022-2024 sources, which matches the current GEM value -- but flagging for awareness since it is a real numeric discrepancy in the public record, not a typo of the same source.
